subject: gk
question: West Bengal's first oil and gas reserve - the Bengal Basin, dedicated to the nation on 20 December 2020, is the ______ oil and gas producing basin of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**eighth.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bengal Basin is the **eighth**__ oil and gas producing basin of India.
 
• It was dedicated to the nation on **20 December 2020.**
 
• It was officially inaugurated by the then** Minister for Petroleum & Natural Gas and Steel**, **Dharmendra Pradhan.**
 
• It is the** first oil and gas reserve in West Bengal.**
 
• The petroleum reserve in **Ashoknagar** has started with the extracted oil being sent to the Haldia refinery of Indian Oil Corporation (IOC).
 
• The Ashoknagar field falls under the **Mahanadi- Bengal-Andaman (MBA) basin.**
 
• The crude oil discovered at the Asokenagar reserve is of high quality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84a4778b36daceba62e7c25653a2b0d215037875bd45b456c80654bd625573d2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The other **seven oil and gas producing basins of India** are:

 
 
• **Krishna-Godavari (KG).**
 
• **Mumbai Offshore.**
 
• **Assam Shelf.**
 
• **Rajasthan.**
 
• **Cauvery.**
 
• **Assam-Arakan Fold Belt.**
 
• **Cambay.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ONGC** has identified **seven of India's eight producing basins**, accounting for **83% of the country's proven oil and gas reserves.**
 
• The** first oil and gas** reserve in West Bengal was discovered in **2018.**
 
• **ONGC** spent Rs** 3,381 crore** for the **discovery of the Ashoknagar oilfield.**
 
• There are** 26 sedimentary basins in India**, according to the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons, encompassing a total area of 3.4 million square kilometres.
 
 
• Of these, 16 are on land basins, 7 located both on land and offshore, and 3 completely offshore.
